principle: Useful, source-backed content before reach. Engagement language cannot weaken accuracy, context or TSS credibility.

objectives.purpose: Invite a specific, answerable audience view.
Make a checklist or decision framework useful later.
Identify the next evidence-led market comparison.
Help the audience test its own assumptions.
Invite a relevant TSS enquiry without hard selling.

ctaLibrary.text: Which factor would you check first?
Save this for your next property review.
Keep this checklist before comparing options.
Which country should we compare next?
Which market deserves the next evidence check?
Which assumption would you stress-test first?
Does your plan still work under this test?
Send TSS your objective, budget and timeframe.
Share the opportunity you want properly assessed.

rules: A trend must be entered as a reviewed candidate before draft generation.
Every material statement must map to a direct source and evidence excerpt.
Publication date, measurement period, geography and provisional status must be explicit.
Migration counts cannot be presented as proof of tax motivation without separate evidence.
Search interest, social discussion and news coverage indicate attention, not market truth.

repurposingPolicy.rule: One researched subject may become multiple formats only when each has a different hook, audience value, visual and format role.

rules: Do not imply a client relationship, outcome or endorsement without evidence and permission.
Do not disclose private client, investor, owner, partner or project information.
Use the exact measured result and period. Do not generalise one result into a promise.
Each factual slide maps to a reviewed source.
The final slide uses one approved CTA.
Every slide needs its own crop, readability and brand inspection.
Do not optimise from one post.
Reach alone cannot overrule accuracy or audience relevance.
Only explicit approved learnings may influence future CTA or hook selection.
